title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot!

meta.Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm finishing my English review sooner than expected. I'll quickly memorize the rest of the vocab.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, this word can be used in a lot of different ways... But how specifically? I think I'll try finding some examples...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An ad for chocolates...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's right. Valentine's Day is coming up...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We've been so busy that it completely slipped my mind... But I'd still like to give chocolates to everyone. Plus, having something sweet might be a nice break from practice.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho would really love this chocolate bunny. And Minori might like these chocolate flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... These chocolate bonbons look so fancy. They look so yummy too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What brand are these...? Couleur Chocolat...? Wait, I've heard that name before somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane, check out these chocolates in this article! Don't they look amazing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? These are made of chocolate?
I thought they were makeup palettes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because they are! This cosmetics brand and chocolate company decided to make some stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
It says, “A collaborative effort between Couleur Chocolat and Colore Mi.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this lipstick's also made of chocolate. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? I'm not usually into this kind of stuff, but I thought these were so cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the chocolate this company makes is known to be really good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I wanna try them even just once.
But they're so cute that I might want to put them on display somewhere instead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's the chocolate company An was talking about...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does this mean they're still selling that chocolate makeup? I'll try checking their website...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're all sold out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Both brands are really famous, so I'm sure a lot of people wanted these...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aww... If only I'd looked into it a little sooner...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But there's no use moping. I'll just have to find something else...)
After school

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Alright, I need to do my best again at practice.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But we're not scheduled to meet for a bit, so I think I'll use this time to search up about the event we're performing in today.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Huh? Is it just me, Ishii, or did you put on more makeup than usual today?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Shh! I don't want the teachers to find out!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: I just went and retouched everything because I'm thinking about taking a picture of myself for this photo contest.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: A photo contest?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah! And the winners get an awesome prize!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Check it out!
You can win these special chocolates made by Couleur Chocolat in collaboration with Colore Mi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Wow, these are so pretty!
Hold on. This prize includes makeup by Colore Mi too?!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
This even comes with an assortment of these brands' other bestselling items!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Oh my gosh. Maybe I'll send in an entry too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Did I hear them right...?
You can win that set of chocolate makeup...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I-I need to search this up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, here it is...!
Wow, you really can win them and a bunch of makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, if I were to somehow win, I'd be able to give these to An...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll take a closer look at the rules after I get home...!)
A few hours later
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, so the rules for this photo contest are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Entrants are required to use cosmetic products by Colore Mi and send in their photos through the entry website listed here.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Entries will be ranked based on an online poll, and the highest ranked entries will receive a glamorous prize!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I have to put on their makeup, take a photo of myself and send it in... I'm not so sure about this now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, I hardly ever put on any makeup. Also, as much as I like photography, photos of myself are a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't own any makeup, but I can at least practice taking photos of myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Hmm... I can try using my DSLR...
But my phone might be better for taking a close-up photo of myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll use my index and pinky fingers to hold it steady, and then use my thumb to press the shutter button...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...
It's hard to keep my hand steady and press the button at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My fingers are starting to cramp...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh... I got so caught up in trying to press the button that I forgot to look at the camera...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll keep my eyes on the lens next time and...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Now I look really tense...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Smile... Relax...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
My smile's all crooked...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (B-But I have to keep trying! For An's sake...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know. The timer function might make things easier...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've tried a lot of different poses and angles, but nothing's working...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And on top of forgetting to look at the camera, my smile ends up looking weird every time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Am I just not cut out for this...?
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How was practice today? I heard that it was pretty tough.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was. The time just flew by since we tried to work on as many things as we could...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, I have just the thing to help you recover. Why don't you try some of this new drink I just made?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow.... Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, are you open?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
It's business as usual here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, we don't want anything “usual”!
We're here to try some of that new drink!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, how do you two already know about that? I don't remember telling either of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I noticed that you'd been testing a few things out lately, so I figured that you'd have a new menu item ready soon!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, we came to check after bumping into Toya along the way!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
Honestly, how is it that you're able to sniff out these things so fast?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, here it is. The chocolate special.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, this looks so yummy...!
The whipped cream with chocolate chips on top is also really cute.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I made sure yours isn't quite as sweet, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
This cacao aroma is incredibly soothing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Valentine's Day is just around the corner, so I decided to make some coffee with some chocolate in it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still haven't decided what I'm going to do about my chocolates for An...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Valentine's Day? I guess it is that time of the year already...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's also a time of year when we encounter more yummy stuff! Like this new drink! It's so good♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Kohane, are you going to give out chocolates again this year?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan.
To An, my friends, everyone in SEKAI and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, us too? I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you already know what you're going to give us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I have something picked out for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Except...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. This means you have to win the chocolates you want to give An from this photo contest...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You said Couleur Chocolat, yes...?
I remember Akito saying the other day how the chocolates they make are very good.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And they're super pretty!
I can see why you want to give these to An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, but none of the photos I took so far have turned out very well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really?
But you're so skilled in photography...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I like taking photos of other people, but I always get a little nervous when the camera's flipped around.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's why I was thinking that maybe I'm not cut out for this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Question, Kohane!
Do you have to send in a picture of yourself?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, a lot of people were uploading selfies, but I don't think you have to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you have someone else be your model? That way, you'd be able to focus on working the camera!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. That'd allow you to make better use of your skills, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But finding a model doesn't sound easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you have Toya be your model?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a great idea! Toya's cool, stylish and photogenic!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
Also, you might really enjoy this experience since it's not every day that you get to model for something, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'd like to help you, Azusawa...
But are you sure I'm the right person for the job? I've never used makeup before, and I'm not used to having my picture taken...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I was actually hoping that you'd agree to be my model, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also don't know much about makeup, but I'm going to learn what I can to find a look that suits you. So, please...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay...
If you're willing to say that, then I'll be your model.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Aoyagi!
Still, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In return... Would it be possible for you to share some of your chocolate prizes with me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just remembered that Akito said he was hoping to have them again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...!
Then, we can give the chocolate bonbons that are supposed to be included to Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're teaming up?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good luck, you two.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm still a little worried since I don't really know much about makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aoyagi agreed to help me try to win those yummy chocolates for An and Shinonome, so...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to do my best...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
When should we do our shoot?
I'm guessing we have a deadline to meet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, the deadline for entry is next Saturday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I need to study about makeup and find a place to do our shoot. Also, that's the only day next week when we're not scheduled to have practice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, it sounds like we don't have a choice but to do our shoot just before the deadline...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll also try researching what I can by then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks! Let's both do our best!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, my order's in!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank goodness they still had some of these chocolates left. They were just the ones I've been wanting to try...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting Mizuki to say that we should throw a party for Valentine's Day in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess it'll be fun since we'll all get to have chocolates and I already bought some online too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I really wanted the ones Colore Mi and Couleur Chocolat made...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I had a feeling they'd run out, but not in seconds.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That chocolate-patterned eye shadow and heart-shaped blush would've gotten so much buzz online...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A photo contest?
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll stop here for today.
Next time we'll be starting by going over your homework assignment, so please make sure to have it complete by then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So you're supposed to thoroughly clean your skin first before applying your base makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wait...
Primer, foundation, concealer...
There's a lot more involved than I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was hoping to learn what I could during this break, but this is turning out to be really complicated...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I have to do my best for Aoyagi's sake! I'll just have to go step by step...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane, are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Haruka...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry for coming so suddenly, but I came to return that notebook you lent me earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right... Thanks for bringing it back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you for writing such beautifully organized notes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to catch up without it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, you had this really serious look on your face while holding...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A cosmetics magazine...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm... This is just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry too.
I was a little surprised is all since you don't usually wear any makeup.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's okay, really.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's just... One thing led to another and I'm having to do some research on the subject.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Now I see...
You're learning more about makeup for your photo contest entry.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and I'll be the one doing Aoyagi's makeup...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But on top of everything that I need to get, I have to figure out how to apply it. Which is why I'm starting to get a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But for An and Shinonome's sake...
And for Aoyagi's sake since he agreed to help me... I need to cram as much as I can...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't I lend you a hand?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned how to do makeup from a stylist a little while back, so I can try teaching you what I know.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I should also be able to give you some advice when it comes to posing and stuff for your shoot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'd really appreciate it...
But are you sure? Aren't you really busy with work...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You said you're doing your shoot on Saturday, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just happen to have that day off, so I should be able to join you. We have a little more free time now after hiring a manager.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind spending part of your day off with us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd love to. This is the least I can do since you've been nice enough to share your notes and stuff with me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
I promise to do what I can too.
The day of the shoot
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, over here...!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, Kohane! And you're Aoyagi, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it's been a while.
I'm a complete novice when it comes to modelling, so I can't thank you enough for being here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with you today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
I'll do my best to help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, can we begin by going over the rules and guidelines for this contest again...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to go over them again as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I'll read out what the site says.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Let's see...
“Entrants are required to use cosmetic products by Colore Mi and send in their photos through the entry website listed here.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, we're actually allowed to use other brands, but we at the very least have to use Colore Mi for eye shadow and lips...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. We can discuss that in further detail when we're picking out our cosmetics.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay. Anyway, I'll continue...
“The theme of this contest is Valentine's Day.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Valentine's Day...?
How do you capture that using makeup?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm guessing they want us to capture certain aspects of Valentine's Day through makeup.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, using dark chocolate browns for a more mature look or a combination of pinks to appear more sweet is pretty standard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Again, we can decide what we're going to do when we're choosing our makeup.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad we have a professional on our side.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm no makeup artist, but I should at least be able to teach you the basics.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, Kohane, what comes next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh...
“Each entrant may submit up to three photos. Entries will be ranked based on the total number of likes they receive.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Voters may like up to five photos. If one finds a photo they like more, they will be able to reconsider their previous choices.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I was under the impression that the early bird would get the worm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If people are able to change their votes, then it seems prudent to take the highest quality photos we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Let's take our time to take the best ones we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remind me again when we have until?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... All photos must be submitted by five this afternoon, and voting will end at nine this evening.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The rankings will be finalized once the likes have been calculated.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Which means we'll get to see the results later tonight...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Only the top ten get prizes, so let's do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, time is of the essence, so let's get started. First, we need to grab some makeup.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The cosmetics department on this floor has a unisex powder room, so we can apply everything there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!
Cosmetics Department

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... Colore Mi should be somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
This is astounding...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong... I couldn't help but feel somewhat stunned since I'd only ever seen this area from afar.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't realize cosmetics came in so many different shapes and sizes. There appears to be a countless number of these makeup pens alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was surprised my first time too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is, a lot of these look the same, but they all have their uses. Like coloring in your brows or lining your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These liquids and gels go on differently depending on what was used to make them. We'll discuss those in more detail when we decide which to buy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka...
This eye shadow palette apparently includes some limited edition Valentine's Day colors.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, this chocolate-colored one's really cute. It goes perfectly with our theme, so why don't we get it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: One is more brown and the other is more orange. Which should we choose...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, you seem like the cool and collected type, so the brown one might help us achieve that dark chocolate look I mentioned earlier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Plus, your skin tone calls for a more subdued color.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
My skin tone...?
I didn't realize we had to take that into consideration. You really do know quite a lot about this subject.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Only because of work.
But I'm glad this has all come in handy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start grabbing whatever else we need.
Powder Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think we have all the makeup we need...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's start applying it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I tried doing it myself first?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know how I'll do, but I always like to try new things whenever possible...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Then, I'll show you what to do and you can copy me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good...
Your eye shadow has a nice gradation to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... That eye shadow alone makes you look like a completely different person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's designed to make your eyes look more three-dimensional, and a bit of eyeliner should help reinforce that illusion.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That involves literally drawing right around your eyes and eyelashes, right? I'm really not sure how I'm going to do with that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Gel liners like these are pretty easy to use, so you don't have to worry. There's also a simple trick to getting the lines you want.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And finish by using the brush to put on a thin layer of lipgloss.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hmm... I honestly only have good things to say about this.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Me too!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But you want to take an even better one, right, Kohane?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Actually...
In your mind, what makes a photo “good”?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If you clarified that, then we might be able to figure out the solution to this problem!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: To me, a good photo is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's really hard to put into words...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I try to copy the way other people frame things and use lighting, but that alone doesn't guarantee quality...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There are plenty of great photos out there that don't adhere to basic foundations.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, what is it that makes a photo “good”...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, Kohane! It wasn't meant to be such a hard question!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I'm sorry for not being able to find the right words...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's understandable. If someone asked me what makes a song “good”, I probably wouldn't be able to give a quick response either.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know...! Kohane, can you tell us about some of the times when you thought you took some really good pictures?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: When I...? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think the photos I took of a show I saw at PXL are the first ones that I thought were really good...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <PXL? You mean that amusement park you really love?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was in junior high school and it was the first time I took a photo using the camera my dad gave me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The show was so magical. I got so excited that I couldn't help but take so many photos.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Most of them didn't turn out great. They were blurry and poorly framed...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I liked what I took...
I still feel that way even when I look at them now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Why's that?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I don't really know why...
But I get really excited whenever I look at them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Seeing the cast members' bright smiles and the sparkling lights puts me right back in that moment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see... Then, it sounds like those photos mean quite a lot to you.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
They really do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I feel like all the pictures you take are beautiful and compelling... I always get excited whenever I look at them...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you do...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes! I remember one of those flowers that looked so pretty in full bloom... Or that family of cats, which was so heartwarming...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's clear what you were feeling each time you went to capture a scene.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Which is why I really love your work, Kohane. I think all the pictures you take are good.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She understands what my photos are really about. That makes me so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(So, all my photos...
I guess they're a record of what I felt after seeing those things...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which allows me to go back in time, relive them and even share them with others... Is that why I love photography so much?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, to me, a “good” photo is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I think I know how to answer your question now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, really?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes... I want to leave a record of the things that really move my heart.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And take photos in a way that others can understand what I was feeling. That's my aim...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm not really sure if that's the best way to receive likes from others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Who cares?
You should take the photos you want, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <What he said! Because if you don't think what you took is good, then there's no way others will!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <However, based on that logic, Kohane, you'll need to take a picture of Toya that you personally like...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hmm... What does that entail?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, was that a lightbulb?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm.... What if we took one of him smiling?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Smiling?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. When we first formed our team, Aoyagi's facial expressions didn't really change much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But as we spent more time together, he slowly began to learn how to smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which sort of felt like evidence that we'd become close enough that he's willing to open up to us. I remember how happy I was after realizing that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, if we can somehow recreate that heartwarming atmosphere, then I think everyone who sees it will really like it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yeah, that's a wonderful idea!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Then, for your last attempt, you'll be going for Toya's smile...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I genuinely believe that a photo of him smiling will end up being the best one we take today!

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line: Trying to relax is more difficult than I realized...

rows.Line: So, instead of forcing out a smile, you could try thinking about some fun or happy memories from your past.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My memories...?

rows.Line: Yes, this method helped me learn how to smile more.

rows.Line: Huh? But you're...

rows.Line: You did?

rows.Line: I'm also surprised. I was under the impression that all idols were good at that...

rows.Line: Hehe. I'm good at it now.

rows.Line: But I really did used to have a lot of trouble smiling...

rows.Line: Then I met this idol while she was doing an event at a mall, and she asked me to join her on stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remember having so much fun dancing with her. The audience really enjoyed seeing that, which in turn made me unbelievably happy...

rows.Line: Before I knew it, I had a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That really happened?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Now, I can't help but smile whenever I think about that moment.

rows.Line: Which is why I think you should try doing the same thing, Aoyagi. Try remembering a moment that really made you smile.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: You seemed to have a lot of fun while pitching the tents and chopping vegetables.

rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Line: Not only did we work together to accomplish various things that time, I got to experience a lot of new things.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I definitely enjoyed seeing my horizons expand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like a really important memory.

rows.Line: Yes, and... I was elated after completing my very first track.

rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You were able to after asking Soma for advice.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: (Oh, Aoyagi seems a little more relaxed now...)

rows.Line: You were also really happy when you heard the news that An and Shinonome weren't getting held back...

rows.Line: But they studied very hard for their last finals for the year, so I was ecstatic after I heard the news that they'd passed.

rows.Line: I can only hope that they received passing scores...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the way you smiled just now felt really natural.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It did...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it was such a nice expression.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An's told me all about your team, but you're much closer than I realized.

rows.Line:
Not only that...

rows.Line: Yes, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've managed to come this far after deciding to work towards making our collective dream a reality, experiencing new things and overcoming various obstacles...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito, Shiraishi and Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, that look...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Yes! Now's my chance...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Got it, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
You got that? But I didn't really do anything...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The fact that you can't tell what just happened is proof of how natural it was.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. And I got you smiling just the way I wanted, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you both so much. I think this is our best one yet, and it wouldn't have been possible without either of you...!

rows.Line: It's like you're trying to tell the viewer something, and that mischievous look on your face is so cute.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
